graph.title: LEGO Speed Champions 75878 Bugatti Chiron
notes: The remaining 4 groups are the Bugatti and the three orange traffic cones from page 3. The cones are a separate '3x' sub-model that the booklet builds on its own, each a cone on a 1x1 plate, and it never attaches them to the car (the cover picture shows them standing on the road). So they are correctly separate and I kept them unconnected rather than invent a join.

The minifigure (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) on page 3 is not in the parts list and has no catalogue type, so it is omitted. The wrench (b1) is held by the minifig. I joined it to the car with a contact edge to the first wheel, because page 43 shows it removing the wheel cover.

The sticker sheet (b151) is applied to the car with 'sticker' joined edges: stickers 1-2 on the step 12 sub-assembly (b32), 3-4 on the windscreen, 5 on b147, and 6-9 on the nose curved bricks. These edges are approximate.

Step pictures are small, so many attachments are best guesses at which piece a part sits on (for example the rear sub-assembly in steps 4-18, the cockpit plates in steps 23-37 and the nose in steps 50-62). The set of parts and the overall structure are reliable. Individual pairings may be off.

The inventory lists 4x wheel cover 24308a plus 4x 24308b, but the manual shows only 4 covers. I put one of each on every wheel to match the inventory. Cover a is joined to the wheel and cover b is only in contact.
The 4 wheels are placed on the pin-holes of the two 18975 bricks: b19 for the front pair, b3 for the rear pair.
The red belt (b52) is stretched around the two round-plate stacks and is marked flexible.
The step 36 hood segments are a 2x repeat. Each segment's plate is attached to the blue 1x3 plates b75 and b76.
